* Wheelchair accessible patrons may purchase up to 3 companion seats with each wheelchair accessible space. Please note that the mezzanine and balcony, while they can be reached via elevator, have stairs and are not accessible for wheelchair transfers.

* Limited mobility patrons may purchase limited mobility seating. Boston Opera House has an elevator which can access all levels of the theater. There are no railings on any seating aisles. The mezzanine and balcony have stairs and are not accessible for mobility impairments.

* Sight-impaired and deaf patrons may purchase sight-/hearing-impaired seating.

* Hearing-impaired patrons may purchase sight-/hearing-impaired seating, but may also be accomodated by purchasing regular availability seating and obtaining hearing-impaired devices which can be accessed at coat check upon entry. boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: If you require accommodation, we encourage you to reach out to information@crossroadspresents.com as soon as you have purchased your GA ticket.
boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The Paradise Rock Club Box Office is open for ticket purchases from 12 PM to 6 PM, Monday through Friday. On show nights, the Box Office will remain open until approximately 15-30 mins after the headliner takes the stage. If traveling from out of town, please call the customer line at 617-562-8801 to verify hours.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: We accept Cash (American currency only), American Express, Discover, Visa, and Mastercard. Apple/Google/Samsung Pay is also accepted. We are unable to accept checks.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: All tickets sold for Paradise Rock Club are delivered digitally, unless otherwise denoted. Tickets sold in person will be delivered via telephone number or email address. Will call is available only on the night of the show. A valid photo I.D. is required for ticket pickup. Note: Artist will call is typically not available until around 1 hour prior to doors, but times vary per event.

venues.parkingDetail: The Paradise Rock Club does not offer onsite parking. There are opportunities for street parking in the area, as well as multiple Boston University owned garages. Please plan your trip accordingly. The two closest garages to The Paradise are as follows: Lot B: Langsam Garage Automated parking facility located at 142 Gardner St, Boston, MA 02215. Lot A and Lot C2: Agganis Arena Parking Garage and Open Lot Automated parking facility located at StuVi2 33, Harry Agganis Way, Boston, MA 02215
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: We have an area stage left set up for an unobstructed view. Patrons in need of this space should purchase a general admission ticket and contact the venue to make arrangements. Please contact us by calling the Paradise Rock Club Box Office at 617-562-8800 or emailing information@crossroadspresents.com. Sign language interpreters and assistive listening devices must be requested in advance. Last-minute sign language interpreter requests are subject to interpreter availability. Service Animals are also allowed.

generalInfo.generalRule: Paradise Rock Club does not have a specific bag policy. ALL ITEMS ARE SUBJECT TO SEARCH. Re-entry is allowed with the appropriate stamp as smoking inside the club is strictly prohibited. See staff at the door before stepping outside. Guests, including law enforcement personnel not present in an official capacity, are prohibited from bringing weapons into the venue. For a full list of prohibited items, please visit the Crossroads Presents official website.
generalInfo.childRule: Patrons under the age of 18 wishing to attend an 18+ show may do so as long as they are accompanied by a parent or guardian. All guests over the age of one year old require a ticket.
